## Bug

The mcp2cli Open Brain skill references still default promotion/scan targets to the **legacy `collab`** namespace, but `shared-kb` is now canonical. Following these docs sends promotions to a frozen/dead namespace.

Stale references found in `~/.config/mcp2cli/skills/open-brain/`:
- `references/entry-ops.md`: `promote_entry` "Promote an entry from an agent namespace to **collab**", `target_namespace ... (default: collab)`
- `references/namespace-ops.md`: `scan_namespace` "candidates (not yet in **collab**), duplicates (already in **collab**)", `target_namespace ... (default collab)`
- `references/general-ops.md`: namespace filter examples use `'collab'`
- `SKILL.md`: `promote_entry | Promote an entry from an agent namespace to **collab**...`

## Data context (open-brain DB, 2026-06-19)

`thoughts` table: collab=11,943 (11,874 already mirrored in shared-kb by content_hash; 69 not). No collab writes since 2026-06-18 18:15. shared-kb=11,875. collab is a frozen legacy population; shared-kb is canonical.

## Fix

Update the mcp2cli OB skill references + SKILL.md so promotion/scan defaults and examples use `shared-kb`, not `collab`. Verify the actual `promote_entry`/`scan_namespace` server defaults too (open-brain `promote-entry.ts` — confirm the tool's default target_namespace).

## Scope note
This is rtech-mcps / mcp2cli skill territory (`~/.config/mcp2cli/skills/open-brain/`), downstream of the open-brain repo. Logged here for tracking; fix lands in the mcp2cli/skill source.

## Provenance
Surfaced 2026-06-19 while building the first-class promoter role (#159). Rico flagged tooling still pointing at collab.

**Local side fixed; hosted refresh pending deploy approval.**

Findings:
- Root cause: the skill files under ~/.config/mcp2cli/skills/open-brain/ are AUTO-GENERATED from the MCP schema cache. OB server schemas (promote-entry.ts, scan-namespace.ts) and the mcp2cli generator were ALREADY correct (shared-kb); the generated files were built against a stale cache with empty inputSchema properties, so the target_namespace param tables were missing entirely.
- Fix: regenerated locally via `mcp2cli generate-skills open-brain --conflict=merge` against the fresh (2026-07-04) cache. `grep -rni collab` over the skill dir → zero matches; `target_namespace (default: shared-kb)` tables now present in entry-ops.md / namespace-ops.md; general-ops.md examples now use 'shared-kb'.
- No open-brain or mcp2cli source change required — nothing to PR.

Remaining before close (deploy-gated):
- Hosted refresh per docs/downstream-rollout.md §4 (CT216 / rtech-mcps side) so the hosted daemon serves the same regenerated skills.

Durable-fix note: regeneration against a stale cache can reintroduce this (known cache-invalidation gap, mcp2cli#58).
